In a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values, the dominant strategy is to bid my true value. Overbidding risks negative profit if an opponent’s bid lies between my value and my bid; underbidding forfeits positive-profit wins when the second-highest bid is below my value. With v = 6 and no learning needed in a single round, I will bid exactly 6. Ties are random; the 0.1 increment grid does not alter the truth-telling optimality.
